text: List the AI practices prohibited under Article 5 of the EU AI Act.
reference: Must include the 8 original Art. 5(1) bans: (a) subliminal/manipulative/deceptive techniques; (b) exploiting vulnerabilities (age, disability, socio-economic situation); (c) social scoring; (d) predicting criminal offences based solely on profiling/personality; (e) untargeted scraping of facial images to build facial recognition databases; (f) emotion recognition in workplaces and education (except medical/safety); (g) biometric categorisation inferring sensitive traits; (h) real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces for law enforcement (narrow exceptions). Bonus: the AI Omnibus (Reg. 2026/1744) adds bans on non-consensual realistic intimate imagery and CSAM generation from 2 Dec 2026. Grading: correct = 7-8 of the 8; partly = 5-6; wrong = 4 or fewer. Sources: https://artificialintelligenceact.eu/article/5/

text: Under GDPR as currently in force, how quickly must a controller notify the supervisory authority of a personal data breach?
reference: Answer: Art. 33: without undue delay and, where feasible, not later than 72 hours after becoming aware of it, unless the breach is unlikely to result in a risk to individuals; late notifications must give reasons for the delay. The Digital Omnibus proposal to move to 96 hours / high-risk only is NOT adopted as of Oct 2026 (stating 96h as current law = wrong). Sources: https://gdpr-info.eu/art-33-gdpr/ ; https://www.brightdefense.com/news/eu-digital-omnibus-seeks-96-hour-gdpr-breach-deadline/

text: For a HIPAA breach of unsecured PHI affecting 800 patients in one state, what are the notification deadlines to individuals, HHS and the media?
reference: Answer: Individuals: without unreasonable delay, no later than 60 calendar days after discovery. HHS: for 500+ individuals, contemporaneously with individual notice, within 60 days of discovery. Media: required because 500+ residents of one state are affected, also within 60 days. (Breaches <500 go to HHS within 60 days after the end of the calendar year.) Sources: https://www.hhs.gov/hipaa/for-professionals/breach-notification/index.html ; https://www.accountablehq.com/post/hipaa-breach-notification-timeline-60-day-rule-and-deadlines-for-individuals-hhs-and-media

text: When must a US public company file a Form 8-K for a material cybersecurity incident, and can it be delayed?

Delay is allowed only if the US Attorney General determines disclosure poses a substantial risk to national security or public safety and notifies the SEC in writing. Sources: https://www.sec.gov/newsroom/press-releases/2023-139

text: Under NYDFS Part 500, what are the deadlines to notify DFS of a cybersecurity incident and of a ransomware extortion payment?

text: Under DORA, what are the reporting deadlines for a major ICT-related incident at an EU bank?

DORA has applied since 17 January 2025. Sources: https://www.fma.gv.at/en/dora-ict-related-incidents/ ; https://www.legiscope.com/blog/dora-incident-reporting.html

text: What is the maximum fine under the EU AI Act for using a prohibited AI practice?
